lines.t:
Equipment that makes up a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>'s body.

Each {{part}} has a defined <c:ffff00>{{slot}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{gender}}<c>, and is
fitted to the <c:ffff00>{{tinpet}}<c> accordingly.

It has features such as <c:ffff00>{{model_number}}<c>, <c:ffff00>action<c>, <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c>
and <c:ffff00>{{part|cap}} Trait<c>. The combination of the 4 slots
decides much of the {{medabot}}'s abilities and
appearance.
